analysis.insight_summary: Users report challenges locating downloadable 3D CAD files (such as .stp format) for specific [company_name] [product_name] hardware. Available resources, including databases and installation media, typically offer only rendered visuals or 2D images instead of usable 3D models. This indicates a lack of straightforward access to preferred 3D formats for CAD integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] to offer direct and convenient downloads of 3D model files (STEP/.stp) for [product_name] hardware modules.
